```{r}
departments <- c(
  "Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"
)

department_names <- c(
  "Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information Systems & Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"
)

fsb_df <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(departments)){
  dept_url <- paste0("https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/", departments[i], "/all")
  
pg <- rvest::read_html(dept_url)

names <- pg |>
  rvest::html_elements("#sidebar-main table td:nth-child(3) strong a") |>
  rvest::html_text2()

title <- pg |>
  rvest::html_elements("#sidebar-main table td:nth-child(3) i") |>
  rvest::html_text2()

website <- pg |>
  rvest::html_elements("#sidebar-main table td:nth-child(3) strong a") |>
  rvest::html_attr("href")

dept_df <- data.frame(
  department = department_names[i],
  name = names,
  position = title,
  website = website
)

fsb_df <- rbind(fsb_df, dept_df)
}

head(fsb_df)


# double checking answers
table(fsb_df$department)
head(fsb_df$website)
```
